# Objective

Tune a Ridge penalty using expanding chronological folds, then evaluate the selected procedure on a later holdout block.

# Run

```bash
python python/qm020_time_series_tuning.py
```

# Experiment

Change `gap`, the minimum training size, or the strength of the synthetic regime change. Explain why a gap is justified or unnecessary from the label-information design rather than choosing it mechanically.

The data are synthetic and provide no empirical forecasting claim.
